independentSourcePixelInventory.observation: One continuous left-to-right optical schematic, not multiple panels. A slightly descending solid principal axis joins the object base, both lens regions, intermediate-image base and rear of the eye. No grid, numerical distances, units, scale or separate subfigures.

Short upright AB at far left, with A above B. Between the two lenses A1B1 is inverted and larger, with A1 below the shared axis and B1 on it. At the rear of the eye A2 lies above the axis and B2 on it. All six letter labels and all three object/image strokes are present in the source; A2 is not a virtual-image construction.

First lens is a vertical outward double-arrow symbol near source x194. Two hollow axis focus marks lie near x84 and x311. Above the lens a solid F1 bracket extends to the right-focus vertical guide. The object is to the left of the left focus. One incident ray from A is approximately axis-parallel; the other passes through the objective center.

Second lens is the vertical outward double-arrow symbol near source x658. The solid F2 bracket spans from the vertical guide through B1 to the eyepiece plane. B1 and A1 share the intermediate-image plane to the left of the eyepiece.

Two solid forward rays start at A, change direction at the objective, meet at A1, then continue without a bend there toward the eyepiece. Beyond the eyepiece they travel approximately parallel toward the anterior side of the single closed eye outline and converge at rear point A2. The eye includes the source's anterior bulge and posterior boundary. The rays have forward arrowheads; there are no dashed virtual extensions.

Source labels are A, B, A1, B1, A2, B2, F1 and F2, with typographic subscripts in the scan. Source axis, rays, lens symbols, focus brackets, guides and eye contour are solid. No apparatus-name text or dashed eye-lens guide is a source fact.
independentSourcePixelInventory.declaredModernChanges: Levelled axis; coherent schematic coordinates instead of tracing scan distortion; ASCII subscript labels; English Objective, Eyepiece, Eye lens and Retina names; muted dashed eye-lens refraction guide. None is misclassified here as original-source wording or a new numerical given.

scientificReview.method: Independent visual comparison and read-only inspection/arithmetic on the existing spec. No native validator or renderer invoked.

objective.observation: AB is upright, A1B1 inverted and enlarged. The central ray is straight through the objective center; the initially horizontal ray crosses the right-focus marker before meeting the other ray at A1.

eyepiece.observation: A1B1 is the object at the eyepiece's front focal plane. The two outgoing rays are parallel to each other, not parallel to the principal axis. They represent one off-axis point, not every point of the object.

eyeAndRetina.observation: Both forward rays converge at A2 after the simplified eye refraction plane. A2 is the retinal image above B2, not the eyepiece's virtual image. The eye reinverts the inverted intermediate image. The schematic is not a scale drawing or complete anatomical eye model.

scientificReview.bilingualContext: Both d703 modern prose candidates distinguish object A, intermediate real image A1 and retinal image A2. Both explain the focal-plane, parallel-bundle arrangement and qualify relaxed viewing by the eye's ability to focus distant objects. The current figure supports these statements; it neither applies a universal eye-health claim nor supplies an exercise answer.

observations: All twelve labels are readable and visibly separated from one another at 640px. No clipping, black raster, missing image stroke or misplaced apparatus label observed.
The intermediate crossing, the two separate outgoing parallel rays, their convergence at A2, both objective focus marks and F1/F2 brackets remain inspectable.
Arrowheads mark forward propagation. Their overlap at actual ray intersections does not introduce an extra image or lens.
The dashed guide is visibly different from the solid rays and is identified by Eye lens. The eye outline retains an anterior bulge and a posterior retinal region.
Existing measurement receipts, current SVG label data and the inspected PNG agree on the 640px size. These are read-only corroboration, not newly executed acceptance or render checks.
Visible apparatus wording is English; point and focal-length symbols use allowed Latin letters and numbers.
No Chinese or Cyrillic labels, political emblems, handwriting, scan texture, stereotyped people or invented historical wording appear in the candidate.
The simple eye outline is a neutral explanatory schematic. It does not claim photorealistic anatomy.
Visible strokes and labels use semantic ink/muted/paper roles. Only the provided neutral raster theme was visually inspected; alternate-theme and print screenshots were not created.
